title.zh: Who Found the PHP Bug That Made Governments Unplug Their Websites? ChatGPT, Of Course
title.en: Who Found the PHP Bug That Made Governments Unplug Their Websites? ChatGPT, Of Course

current_state.zh: OpenAI says its models discovered the severe PHP2Shell flaws in PHP that prompted several European governments to pull websites offline, and it led a two-month coalition with Calif and Wiz to get the bugs fixed.
current_state.en: OpenAI says its models discovered the severe PHP2Shell flaws in PHP that prompted several European governments to pull websites offline, and it led a two-month coalition with Calif and Wiz to get the bugs fixed.
